agent_mcp.reason: Static bundle; grounded capabilities are exposed as registered local site actions instead of a public MCP facade.

imports.purpose: Ask which prize calls and hackathons are still open — only after the visitor approves on the consent card.

llm_router.note: Inference is bring-your-own-key: visitors may point Settings at any OpenAI-compatible router (Otari is the pre-filled suggestion) and the key stays in their browser, sent only to that router — never to this site or any peer site. With no key configured, the site runs in a clearly-labelled demo mode with local mock specialists, so every flow — including the visit to Deadline Desk, whose board data is live — can be tried offline. (A publisher Otari key was tested on 2026-11-22 and did not authenticate; rather than ship a key wall that fails, the default path is honest demo mode + BYOK.)

networks.description: A friendly reading companion: Rani welcomes you and routes your text to specialist friends — Sari simplifies, Alih translates ID<->EN, Rara summarises. Personal text never leaves your browser.
networks.name: bacajelas
sample_queries: Please simplify this paragraph so a 12-year-old can follow it.
Translate this Indonesian letter into friendly, natural English.
Summarise this long article into five kind bullet points.
This text is personal — explain it simply, and please keep it just between us.

peer_policy.note: No third-party origin is contacted without a friendly consent card naming the destination and purpose. Private context (sly_data) is deny-by-default: no field is allowed to pass to a peer network.
